title: Hearty Bitter Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: This kid‑friendly Algerian tagine delivers a subtle bitter flavor with juicy chicken, enriched by homemade pickle and chicken stock concentrate for a low‑sodium meal.

ingredients.name: 1 cup chicken stock concentrate dissolved in 1 cup water

instructions: Heat olive oil in a tagliere over medium heat until shimmering.
Brown the chicken thighs on all sides for about 4 minutes per side, then remove.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the tagliere and sauté until the onion turns translucent.
Stir in cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and paprika, cooking for 30 seconds to release aromas.
Pour in the dissolved chicken stock concentrate and bring to a gentle boil.
Return the browned chicken to the tagliere, nestle it into the sauce, and reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is tender and the flavors meld.
Stir in chopped pickled olives, chopped cilantro, and lemon juice, seasoning with salt to taste if needed.
Cook uncovered for another 5 minutes to let the sauce thicken slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with extra cilantro, directly from the tagliere.
